draft.body:
Justin Mascarenhas here, I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I came across your profile while looking into the Software Operations Engineer opening on the Vision team at Dockware, and your work sits right in the same space I have been building in, computer vision paired with robotics running in real time.

My background includes a voice controlled robotic arm project where I optimized a YOLO detection pipeline for visual servoing on a Jetson device and built contact aware grasping using time of flight sensors, plus a separate project deriving the full kinematics for a UR5e arm and validating it in ROS2 with MoveIt and RViz. I have also built data pipelines for autonomous vehicle perception, training detection models for tracking within a simulated driving environment.

I would love to hear more about what the Vision engineering team actually works on day to day, and whether you would be open to a short conversation sometime.
draft.hook_used: Shared technical domain (computer vision + real time robotics) and her direct role on Dockware's Vision product, the same product the target role works on
